subject: MAP: Performance eval plan + HW fit recommendations (VectorAI)
top_summary: Mutual Action Plan and performance-evaluation thread for VectorAI. We agreed on a focused MAP to validate latency (p50/p95), TTFT, throughput and concurrency at target batch sizes across A100, H100, and L40S (full-gpu and MIG). Results attached; recommendation: mixed fleet with H100 serving low-latency critical endpoints and L40S for lower-cost high-throughput workloads. Next: procurement window and contract signature by 2026-12-10.
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@vectorai.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@vectorai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft & perf evaluation plan for VectorAI (A100/H100/L40S)

Emily / Ravi —

Following our demo yesterday, attached is a first-pass MAP and the test plan we discussed for performance validation. Focus areas:
- Target SLOs: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 300ms for the 256-token prompt profile; TTFT targets documented for cold vs warm cache.
- Throughput: measurements at 50, 200, and 500 concurrent requests; sustained token/sec targets per model variant.
- Concurrency/burst: steady-state vs burst behaviour and autoscaling thresholds.
- HW matrix: A100 (40GB), H100 (80GB), L40S (full), plus representative MIG splits (1g.5gb / 4g.10gb).

Ask: please confirm the workload profile below (short prompts, service-side streaming to UI, 90% read-only inference, 10% tool-calls). Once confirmed, we'll schedule a 3-day evaluation window where our infra team will run the benchmark harness and share raw traces + summarized CSVs.

Deliverables we will put into the MAP: milestone dates, benchmark results (latency/throughput/TTFT), recommended fleet mix, and procurement/lead times. I've attached version 1 of the MAP milestones (map_milestones_v2.xlsx).

Proposed evaluation window: Nov 24–26 (we can shift to the following week if needed).

Thanks —
Laura
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: map_milestones_v2.xlsx (MAP milestones), perf-plan-outline.md (inline in Drive)
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@vectorai.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@vectorai.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft & perf evaluation plan for VectorAI (A100/H100/L40S)

Laura —

Thanks for the thorough plan. Confirming the workload profile: short prompts (~200 tokens average), synchronous streaming to web client, expected 1k qps peak with typical steady-state 120 qps. 90/10 split is correct.

Evaluation window: we prefer Nov 30–Dec 2 (end of month) to align with our infra availability and procurement folks. Procurement will want the final cost/lead-time recommendation before Dec 10.

Two asks from our side:
1) Please include TTFT (time to first token) broken down by cold cache and warm cache for each GPU variant. That metric is a hard requirement for our UX team.
2) Provide a 'cost per 1M tokens' estimate for each config (rough ballpark is fine).

I'll loop in Procurement once we have results.

—Emily
Head of Platform
VectorAI
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@vectorai.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@vectorai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Results: VectorAI performance benchmark (summary + attachments)

Emily / Ravi —

We completed the evaluation window this morning. High-level summary attached (vectorai_perf_summary.pdf) and raw CSVs (benchmark_results_A100_H100_L40S.csv). Key takeaways:

- TTFT (cold/warm):
  * H100 (full): cold 110ms, warm 32ms (256-token profile)
  * A100 (full): cold 150ms, warm 45ms
  * L40S (full): cold 125ms, warm 40ms
  * MIG slices show increased TTFT variability; 4g slices had warm TTFT ~55ms, 1g slices ~90ms for the same profile.

- Latency (p50/p95 at 120 qps steady):
  * H100: p50 28ms, p95 120ms
  * A100: p50 40ms, p95 180ms
  * L40S: p50 34ms, p95 150ms

- Throughput: sustained tokens/sec per full GPU (256-token prompts): H100 > A100 > L40S by ~25%/10% respectively.

- Concurrency behavior: H100 maintained better p95 under 500 concurrent sessions; MIG 4g split only viable up to ~150 concurrent sessions before p95 spikes.

- Cost estimates (approx):
  * H100 full: $X.XX per 1M tokens (includes model+infra amortized)
  * A100 full: $Y.YY per 1M tokens
  * L40S full: $Z.ZZ per 1M tokens
  * MIG 4g: ~1.6x cost-efficiency tradeoff vs full H100 for non-low-latency paths

Recommendation:
1) For low-latency interactive endpoints (sessional UI), use H100 full-GPU allocation to hit p50/p95 and TTFT SLOs.
2) For bulk/high-throughput batch endpoints (async processing, embeddings or offline rerank), use L40S or A100 depending on price/availability.
3) Use MIG (4g) for cost-optimized, non-latency-sensitive workloads with concurrency under 150.

Next steps I propose for the MAP:
- Finalize fleet mix and commit levels by Dec 6.
- Procurement to review cost estimates and lead times by Dec 9.
- Contract signature target: Dec 15.

I've attached the summary and CSVs. Happy to jump on a short call to walk the team through the traces.

Thanks —
Laura

Attachments: vectorai_perf_summary.pdf, benchmark_results_A100_H100_L40S.csv
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@vectorai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@vectorai.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Results: VectorAI performance benchmark (summary + attachments)

Laura / Emily —

Great work on the run. A couple of pragmatic notes from runtime sizing perspective:
- If VectorAI wants to guarantee p95 < 200ms at 500 concurrent sessions, plan for an H100-heavy front tier with autoscaler thresholds tuned to token-in-flight (not just request count). Our tests show p95 safety margins drop rapidly if batching policies are too aggressive.
- Consider using H100 for 60% of interactive capacity, A100 or L40S for the remaining 40% as warmspares / batch nodes. That gives a good balance of cost and headroom.
- Lead time: H100 stock lead is currently ~6–9 weeks for reserved commits in our cloud partner regions; L40S is more available. We'll push for earlier provisioning if procurement confirms a commit.

If you'd like, I can prepare an ops-ready rollout snippet for the MAP that includes autoscaler settings, batch window recommendations, and a sample canary policy.

—Sergio
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
